external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In this webinar, six senior and respected researchers in the field of nutrition science from the universities in China and Finland will present their research. This webinar is organized by the University of Eastern Finland as part of the Finland China Food and Health (FCFH) network.
Professor Qing Gu, Zhejiang Gongshang University
Associate Professor Anne-Maria Pajari, University of Helsinki
Associate Professor Lina Zhang, Jiangnan University
Associate Professor Kirsi Laitinen, University of Turku
Professor Huilian Zhu, Sun Yat-sen University
Moderators: Professor Hani El-Nezamy, Hong Kong University, and Professor Marjukka Kolehmainen, UEF
